title: Royal Sumo — Crownfall
description: Royal Sumo: Crownfall v1.3.0: a 2–10 fighter physics brawler with six arenas, Quick Match/Crown Cup, one or two local players and bots. Self-contained WebGL2 build. Phone-room controls and server implemented; public relay deployment pending.

local: WASD / Space or J / Shift or K or L
second player: arrows / Enter / Right Shift or period or Numpad0
gamepad stick / A or X / B or Y or RB or RT

source.provenance: Imported from the user-supplied royal_sumo_crownfall_v1.3.0.zip. Exact standalone HTML retained under source/original/ and complete editable source/tests under source/project/. The active entry adds the existing CALLBACK camera controls and new phone-room controls as separate adapters; imported simulation and modules are unchanged. The former v0.21 CALLBACK entry and its MIT-licensed Three.js dependency are archived together.
